verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an SSO plugin supporting OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0, an organization plugin with built-in multi-tenancy, and enterprise SSO/SCIM/directory sync, so the core SSO building block exists. Per-organization SSO connections are only implied by these two plugins existing side by side. A community comment also notes some of these features are enterprise-only. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of binding SSO connections to individual organizations, domain verification, just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login, and hands-on corroboration.
